short: Quantum-Dot Sensitized Solar Cells Employing Hierarchical Cu
title: Quantum-Dot Sensitized Solar Cells Employing Hierarchical Cu2S Microspheres Wrapped by Reduced Graphene Oxide Nanosheets as Effective Counter Electrodes

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Pt counter electrodes perform poorly in polysulfide-electrolyte QDSSCs. Wrapping hierarchical Cu2S microspheres with RGO should raise counter-electrode catalysis and charge transport, improving QDSSC efficiency.
states.detail: Absorbed: m1 (HYP/need), m2 (HYP/hypothesis), m3 (DES/base_system), m4 (DES/modification), m5 (DES/variable_sweep), m6 (PRC/synthesis). Premises: Pt counter electrodes are poisoned by polysulfide electrolyte (ref 24)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: GO addition turns Cu2S into flower-like hierarchical microspheres built from more, smaller, thinner nanoflakes. RGO nanosheets wrap the Cu2S microspheres, coverage rising with GO until sheets bury the spheres.

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: RGO sheets hold Cu2S spheres together and to FTO and carry charge, lowering counter-electrode charge-transfer resistance. Polysulfide-reduction activity ranks RGO-Cu2S-2 above Cu2S and far above Pt
states.detail: Absorbed: m13 (MEC/pathway), m14 (PRP/value). Premises: RGO frameworks improve electron transport and particle connection in composite counter electrodes (refs 24, 42); Equivalent circuit Rs + (RCT1||CPE1) + (RCT2||CPE2); low-frequency arc is counter-electrode/electrolyte charge transfer; Larger polysulfide reduction peak current and higher exchange current J0 = RT/nFRct indicate better counter-electrode catalysis

states.title: Performance state
states.head: QDSSC with RGO-Cu2S-2 counter electrode gives the highest PCE: 3.85% vs 3.39% (Cu2S) and 2.14% (Pt)

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: RGO-wrapped hierarchical Cu2S microspheres make an efficient Pt-free QDSSC counter electrode, ~80% higher PCE than Pt

Linked text places both G bands at 1583 cm-1 and gives 0.99 vs 0.88; panel labels GO G at 1604 cm-1 (text silent on the shift) and 2971 where text says 2933 cm-1.

nodes.title: ECHEM:CV, ECHEM:EIS, ECHEM:Tafel, F6
nodes.head: CV reduction peak near -1.25 V: ~-43 (RGO-Cu2S), ~-41 (Cu2S) mA/cm2; Pt reaches only ~-0.45 mA/cm2. EIS: Pt low-frequency arc spans ~2500 ohm; inset second arcs ~10 ohm (Cu2S, apex ~14 ohm, unclosed at 16) and ~3 ohm (RGO-Cu2S).
nodes.solves: Polysulfide-reduction activity ranks RGO-Cu2S-2 above Cu2S and far above Pt
nodes.note: RGO-Cu2S is only marginally above Cu2S at the reduction peak; Cu2S carries the larger anodic current. Fitted RCT2 in Table S1 (linked text): 2103, 9.905, 3.380 ohm; arc widths read from the plot are consistent in rank and order of magnitude.
nodes.detail: o15: CV reduction peak near -1.25 V: ~-43 (RGO-Cu2S), ~-41 (Cu2S) mA/cm2; Pt reaches only ~-0.45 mA/cm2; o16: EIS: Pt low-frequency arc spans ~2500 ohm; inset second arcs ~10 ohm (Cu2S, apex ~14 ohm, unclosed at 16) and ~3 ohm (RGO-Cu2S); o17: Tafel: log J highest for RGO-Cu2S, slightly lower for Cu2S, about one decade lower for Pt over +-0.3 V
